scope: Actual World skill/support levels, essence credits/debits/conversion, every tree through pick/reset/rechoose, ordered callbacks, legendary/ordinary merge and full-bag support spill; saved and wire investment.
decisions: Unaccepted initial drafts used a nonexistent meta.bar and a numeric trigger flag; corrected to the actual actor.skills bar and boolean state before both final independent captures.
Permission refusals in per-tree courses are controlled host inputs; native cleanup and recalculation run unchanged. Pending repeat sentinels test retirement order, not repeat execution.
limits: No claim to move native world cleanup, delivery execution or persistence into this module.
Negative costs, nonfinite numeric inputs, noninteger tiers and unknown conversion directions are outside the strict SDK boundary; ordinary original authored inputs remain the equivalence target.
